faq_heading: Coquitlam West condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Coquitlam West. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Coquitlam West, Coquitlam: 359 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 35 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 1 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Coquitlam West fell from 390 in June to 359 in September (−7.9%), and 178 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 44.5% of Coquitlam’s 806 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Coquitlam West?
Coquitlam West also had 76 houses listed and 2 sold in September, against 359 condos and townhomes listed. The Coquitlam West houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Coquitlam West home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

389 condos sold in Coquitlam West with a median price of $620,000 (the middle half sold between $509,900 and $728,000), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $835 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $393 a month. 46 townhomes sold in Coquitlam West with a median price of $938,950 (the middle half sold between $799,225 and $1,024,975), taking a median of 36 days to sell at 99.0% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $749 per square foot, a median year built of 2023 and a median strata fee of $423 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Coquitlam West?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 359 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam West. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Coquitlam West a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Coquitlam West had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Coquitlam West from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 178 condos and townhomes sold in Coquitlam West over those 4 months, out of 475 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Coquitlam West sell for?
faq.a: 389 condos sold in Coquitlam West between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $620,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Coquitlam West?
faq.a: The median was 27 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
